item.title: Accelerating LLM Inference Cold Starts: From the First Instance to Scale-Out
item.description: This article was translated from the Chinese original using AI and reviewed by the author. As large language model applications grow, inference services have become a core workload in AI infrastructure. For platform teams, the challenge extends beyond simply getting a model to run; they must also ensure that compute capacity keeps pace with changing demand. On a Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) platform, request volumes can vary significantly between different models, and even the same model’s traffic can fluctuate throughout the day.
